# EzUmrah

> EzUmrah is a cloud-based CRM software built for travel agencies worldwide managing Umrah, Hajj, and holiday packages. It includes 9 modules: group bookings, flight management, hotel reservations, visa tracking, transport & Ziyarat, document vault, quotations & leads, invoicing & payments, and tasks & team management. Trusted by 850+ agencies in 120+ countries.

## What EzUmrah Does

EzUmrah replaces spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and paper files with a proper cloud CRM system designed specifically for Umrah and Hajj travel agencies. Agencies can manage pilgrims, bookings, flights, hotels, visas, transport, invoices, quotations, and documents — all from one dashboard.

## Key Features

- 9 CRM modules (group bookings, flights, hotels, visas, transport, documents, quotations, invoicing, tasks)
- GDS integrations (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo, Travelport)
- White-label booking portals and mobile apps
- Multi-currency invoicing
- Branded invoice and quotation generation
- Document vault with encrypted storage
- Role-based team permissions
- Hajj quota management (Enterprise plan)
- Custom development services

## Pricing

- Starter: $79/month — up to 200 pilgrims, 3 staff accounts
- Agency Pro: $199/month — up to 1,000 pilgrims, 15 staff, GDS integration, white-label
- Enterprise: $499/month — unlimited pilgrims, Hajj quota management, dedicated account manager
- All plans include 14-day free trial, no credit card required

## Who Uses EzUmrah

Travel agencies in 120+ countries including UK, USA, Saudi Arabia, India, Pakistan, Turkey, Malaysia, Indonesia, Egypt, and UAE. Suitable for small agencies launching their first Umrah program and large operators handling thousands of pilgrims.

## GDS Integrations

- Amadeus API integration — 200+ airlines, real-time pricing
- Sabre API integration — Bargain Finder Max, group bookings
- Galileo API integration — Travelport Universal API
- Travelport API integration — multi-GDS, low-cost carriers
